item.title: Trump feels bad about Alex Pretti, ‘worse’ about Renee Good because her parents were ‘Trump fans’
item.description: President Trump admitted he feels "terrible" about the shooting deaths of Alex Pretti and Renee Good, but said he's was more upset about Good because her parents are "Trump fans."

item.title: Democrats visit 5-year-old detained in Minneapolis, in case that has stirred anger over ICE actions
item.description: Protesters banged drums, chanted and carried signs that included “Children are not criminals!”

item.title: Federal troop deployments to US cities cost taxpayers $496M and counting
item.description: The Congressional Budget Office released this estimate after a request from Sen. Jeff Merkley.

item.title: Mayors warn that Trump’s hardline immigration tactics could dent trust in law enforcement
item.description: Many mayors face pressure to remove federal agents.

item.title: EPA plan would begin rolling back ‘good neighbor’ rule on downwind pollution from smokestacks
item.description: The affected states are Alabama, Arizona, Kentucky, Minnesota, Mississippi, Nevada, New Mexico and Tennessee.

item.title: Chinese national who exposed human rights abuses in his homeland is granted asylum to remain in US
item.description: Guan arrived in the U.S. illegally in 2021 and has been in custody since August.

item.title: Florida substitute teacher arrested in school parking lot for DUI
item.description: “This substitute teacher was drunker than Cooter Brown at school while he was supposed to be teaching our children,” said Sheriff Grady Judd.

item.title: Connecticut father fatally shot in dispute over child’s birthday party, police say
item.description: The fatal shooting of a young Connecticut father last week allegedly stemmed from a dispute over his child's upcoming birthday party.

item.title: Michigan Strategic Fund board OKs incentives to keep VW in Michigan
item.description: The company said it plans to relocate its office and administrative functions from its outdated 360,000-square-foot Auburn Hills facility to a smaller 99,000-square-foot site on Opdyke Road.

item.title: Photos of Detroit Country Day vs. Orchard Lake St. Mary’s in a boys hoops contest
item.description: Orchard Lake St. Mary's retained the David Voorhees Memorial Award by defeating visiting Detroit Country Day 50-43 Wednesday night.
